meta.title: LIKED — The recommendation inbox for what to watch
meta.description: Send one link. Friends recommend a movie, show or YouTube video in under 30 seconds, no account needed. Everything lands in one inbox, merged and ready to watch.

hero.title: Stop losing <hl>what your friends tell you to watch.</hl>
hero.sub: Send one link. Friends recommend a movie, show or YouTube video in under 30 seconds, no account needed. Everything lands in one inbox, merged and ready to watch.
hero.micro: Sign in with Google. Basic profile only.
hero.alt: Illustration of the LIKED inbox on a phone: a friend rail with unseen counts and three merged recommendation cards, each showing friends' scores and where to watch. All titles and names are fictional.

s2.title: Friends pick in seconds
s2.body: They search movies, shows and YouTube, tap to add, and can add a score and a note.

s3.title: Your inbox does the rest
s3.body: Duplicates merge into one card. Year, genre, language, rating and where to watch fill in automatically.

flow.title: Faster than typing a text.
flow.body: Poster search means no typos. Three taps and it's sent.
flow.alt: Illustration of the friend flow on a phone: a search box with poster results, a tray of picks, a 0 to 100 percent score slider reading Great, 80 percent, and a send button. All titles are fictional.
flow.prompt: What's the last movie, show or documentary you recommend?

merged.title: One card per title
merged.body: Three friends, one card, three scores.

who.title: Know who said it
who.body: Tap a friend to see only what they sent. Unseen counts show what's new.

where.title: See where it's available
where.body: In your region, filled in automatically.

honest.title: Scores that stay honest
honest.body: Friends' average and public score, never blended.

notify.title: One notification per submission
notify.body: Each time a friend sends picks, you get one ping.

alt.merged: Three friends each recommend the same title with scores 90, 80 and 70 percent; they merge into one card.
alt.who: A friend rail with unseen count badges; one friend is selected.
alt.where: Two fictional streaming service chips next to the label: your region.
alt.honest: Two separate rings: friends' average 80 percent and public score 72 percent.
alt.notify: One notification: Amara sent you a pick.

languages.title: Speaks your language
languages.body: Available in four languages, in light and dark.

final.title: Your next watch is one link away.

c3.quote: Watch it with the lights off.

meta.title: LIKED — Get recommendations from people you trust
meta.description: One link, one tidy inbox. Friends recommend movies, shows and videos in seconds, no account needed. Join the waiting list for the private beta.

hero.eyebrow: A recommendation inbox for movies, shows and videos
hero.title: Get recommendations from people you trust
hero.sub: Share one link. Friends recommend movies, shows and videos in seconds, no account needed. You get one tidy list, with where to watch.
hero.previewAlt: Example of the LIKED inbox with three recommended titles

form.label: Your email
form.notice: We'll use your email only to tell you when LIKED opens to beta testers. We keep it until you ask us to remove it: write to <mail>{email}</mail>.
form.success: You're on the list. We'll email you when beta testers are welcomed.
form.invalid: Please enter a valid email address.
form.error: Something went wrong, please try again in a moment.

why.title: Great tips are everywhere. They're just never in the same place.
why.m3: what was that show Maya mentioned?

s1.title: Share your link.
s1.body: One link for all your friends. Send it by message, story or in person.

s2.title: Friends pick, in seconds.
s2.body: They search movies, shows or YouTube videos, tap to add, optionally give a score and say why you'll love it. No account, no install.

s3.title: You get one list.
s3.body: Duplicates merge into one card. You see who recommended it, their scores, and where to watch in your region.

friends.eyebrow: For your friends: 30 seconds, no account
friends.title: Easier than texting a title.
friends.b1: No sign-in, only a first name.
friends.b3: Add a score and a reason if you feel like it.
friends.reassure: Friends never see each other's picks.
friends.alt: Example of the friend screen: search results with posters, a tray of three picks and a send button.
friends.send: Send to {owner} ({count, plural, one {# title} other {# titles}})

merge.title: Three friends. One card.
merge.caption: We keep who said what, and never blend friends' scores with the public score.
merge.alt: Example: three friends, Alex, Maya and Jules, recommend The Grand Budapest Hotel and it becomes one card. The friends score is 87% from 3 friends. The TMDB score, 81%, is shown separately.
merge.quote: The humor and visual style are exactly your thing.

rail.title: Friend rail
rail.body: See who recommended what, and what's new.

filters.title: Smart filters
filters.body: By genre, year, language and platform.

q1.q: Do my friends need an account?
q1.a: No. They enter a first name and add titles.

q2.a: LIKED has no paid plan today.

q3.q: Where does the movie data come from?
q3.a: TMDB, with streaming availability from JustWatch, plus YouTube for videos.

q4.a: When the beta opens, you'll sign in with Google. LIKED asks only for your basic profile (name, email, photo).

q5.q: How do I remove my email from the waiting list?
q5.a: Write to <mail>{email}</mail> and we'll delete it.

final.title: Your next favorite thing is already on someone's mind.
final.sub: Give your friends a place to recommend it. Leave your email and we'll tell you when the beta opens.
